title: Bellwether
subtitle: Setting · Urban clockpunk fantasy setting pitch

fields.label: Premise
fields.value: A cliffside city powers its hospitals, lifts and night markets with voluntarily borrowed hours. Signed time-debts are tangible records, and their collection changes what people can do with their coming days.

fields.label: Current issue
fields.value: The City Runs on Borrowed Tomorrows: useful public infrastructure depends on debts whose consent is no longer trustworthy.

fields.label: Impending issue / timeline
fields.value: The Thirteenth Bell Will Collect from the Unwilling. The warning sounds at 23:50, records transfer at midnight, the special thirteenth collection bell sounds at 00:10, and the purist cell plans its attack for 00:15. These are threatened events the PCs can change.

fields.label: Faces / forces
fields.value: Nera Quill offers testimony; Vale offers stability at a human cost; the Unwritten offers freedom with an internal argument over evidence and destruction.

fields.label: Places / technology
fields.value: The Archive hangs below the tower; bellwind skiffs cross the upper lanes; the hospital reserve is physically separable from the collection engine. Magic records events but is not automatic mind-reading or prophecy.

fields.label: PC invitation
fields.value: Who once lent you an hour? Whose name would you risk your future to protect? Pick an answer together and connect it to another PC.

fields.label: Tone / boundaries
fields.value: Street-level wonder, civic intrigue and difficult bargains, not mandatory grimdark. Agree comfort with debt, lost time and institutional coercion before play. All fiction here is a new proposal.
